details: The brush 'brush end' handler fires dispatch on every mousemove triggering full re-renders of all three charts (renderBar, renderLine, renderScatter) with no debouncing or RAF coalescing. No .interrupt() calls precede any transition in renderBar/renderLine/renderScatter, so rapid filter changes (quick bar clicks or fast brushing) during the 300ms transitions will cause mid-flight snapping; only reduced-motion users (dur()=0) are immune to both issues.
